WITH transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_all
  FROM transaction_averages
),
kept AS (
  SELECT ta.transref, ta.avg_anlycount, oa.avg_all
  FROM transaction_averages AS ta
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
  WHERE ta.avg_anlycount > oa.avg_all
),
kept_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_kept
  FROM kept
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT k.transref,
         k.avg_anlycount,
         k.avg_anlycount - k.avg_all AS above_overall_average,
         k.avg_anlycount - ka.avg_kept AS above_kept_average,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY k.avg_anlycount - ka.avg_kept DESC) AS rnk
  FROM kept AS k
  CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka
)
SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall_average, above_kept_average
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 10
ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC NULLS LAST;
